raw:
Agent Name: Planner

Step Number: 14

Reason for Mistake: The Planner concluded that Maria of Aragon was Portuguese based on her title "Queen of Portugal," rather than her actual nationality derived from her parentage. Maria of Aragon, as the daughter of Isabella I of Castile and Ferdinand II of Aragon, would be considered Spanish or Aragonese, not Portuguese. The Planner incorrectly interpreted her title as indicative of nationality rather than her origin.
